title: Grateful Dead Live at San Francisco Civic Center on 1987-01-30
lineage: MAC playback on Nakamichi DR-2 > Presonus Firebox/Neutrik Input > firewire > XP Pro PC/Wavelab 5 (recorded as 24bit/96 KHz WAV) > Waves L3, rendered to 16/44.1 using Waves IDR hi res CD dither settings > CDWAV 1.9 > FLAC (level 8 encoding)
source: Nakamichi 100s, taper's section > Sony D5 > Maxell MX90s

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording that sounds great and even beats newer Schoeps sources, though no show details are provided.
ai_review.review: The sole review praises the audio quality, calling it great and superior to a newer Schoeps source, indicating an excellent‑sounding audience capture. No comments were made about the musical performance, setlist, or individual band members, so the show's artistic merits remain unknown.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review focusing on sound quality; it is highly positive about the recording but offers no insight into performance, leading to a cautious rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes the audio sounds great and outperforms a newer Schoeps source; no issues mentioned.
